subject: SCIENCE
title: Why Animals Matter
objective: Describe selected ecosystem roles and humane relationships.
introduction: Bees visit flowers, and worms wriggle in the soil. How do animals help their homes?

vocabulary.definition: A living thing that can move and needs food.
To be important or make a difference, like the roles animals play.
Living things and their home working together.

items.prompt: Which statement about animals' roles is true?

options.text: Every animal has the same role
Animals can pollinate, disperse seeds, improve soil, provide food products, or be companions.

items.explanation: Animals help in different ways — bees pollinate and worms improve soil — and we should treat them kindly. They do not all share one role, and harming animals is never okay.

items.prompt: Which example shows an animal doing a helpful job?

options.text: bees can turn stones into food
bees can make the Sun shine

items.explanation: Bees carry pollen from flower to flower, which helps plants make seeds. They cannot make food from stones or make the Sun shine.

options.text: Every animal has the same role

items.explanation: Animals have different jobs in their homes — worms improve soil and bees pollinate — so they do not all have the same role.

items.prompt: What can some bees help do?
items.explanation: Bees carry pollen between flowers, which helps plants make fruits and seeds. They do not make sunlight or turn stones into plants.

items.prompt: Which example shows a correct animal role?

options.text: some animals grow fur on trees

items.explanation: Some animals carry seeds to new places, which helps plants spread. Animals cannot make rain or grow fur on trees.
